description: Extra names a fully-mapped venue is known by in the NHS ODS register, used by scripts/nhs/build-sites.mjs to recognise that a directory site is already covered. Most venues need no entry — their own name matches the ODS one closely enough. These are the ones where it doesn't: a venue called 'GOSH Wayfinder' shares no words with ODS's 'Great Ormond Street Hospital For Children', so without an alias it would get a duplicate, unnavigable pin sitting on top of the mapped venue. Add an entry whenever a mapped venue's display name diverges from its official name, or when one venue covers several ODS sites.

gosh: Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children
